author: Shintay
quote: GTA 6: From Grand Theft Auto to Grand Fairy Tale. GTA used to be about chaos, crime, controversy, and unapologetic satire. It was a franchise that pushed boundaries, mocked society, and never cared about being politically correct, GTA 6 feels less like Grand Theft Auto and more like Grand Fairy Tale. Instead of the gritty, offensive, unpredictable world that made the series legendary, we seem to be getting a sanitized fantasy designed to please everyone and offend absolutely no one. GTA  was never supposed to be a fairy tale. It was supposed to be dangerous, provocative, and absurd.Rockstar, we wanted Grand Theft Auto, not Grand Theft Disney.
